## Safety And Privacy

- [ ] No diagnosis, prescription, dosage, or autonomous triage behavior was added without required approval.
- [ ] No real personal or health information is present in code, tests, logs, screenshots, or comments.
- [ ] Errors, logs, metrics, and audit events do not expose raw user content.
- [ ] Emergency, prohibited, and unavailable paths remain fail closed.
- [ ] Relevant risks, data inventory, and documentation were updated.
